title: feat: upgrade Polli APIs, search, intelligence, visuals, and deployment
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Responses, Models, function calling, and real-time SSE streaming to Polli.
- Switches Polli to `gpt-5.6-sol` with `glm-5.3` fallback and removes the unused Gemini visualization override.
- Restores and hardens 4K visual attachments with Mermaid, pagination, aggregation, Chromium provisioning, PNG validation, and native link-embed suppression.
- Hardens Discord search permissions, API scoping, result counts, filters, retries, and concurrency limits.
- Adds startup-synchronized code intelligence, symbol resolution, revision provenance, freshness reporting, full-app formatting, and independent deployment from `main`.

gist.headline: Polli learned some new tricks
gist.blurb: Polli can now speak the OpenAI dialect, draw sturdier 4K diagrams, and search Discord without wandering into the wrong garden. The little bee also got a proper independent deployment path, because even mascots deserve to ship on their own schedule.
gist.summary: Polli now exposes OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Responses, Models, function calling, and real-time SSE streaming; uses gpt-5.6-sol with glm-5.3 fallback; and gains hardened 4K Mermaid/PNG visuals, scoped Discord search, code intelligence, and independent deployment from main.
gist.impact: Developers can connect OpenAI-style clients to Polli, receive streamed and tool-enabled responses, get more reliable visual attachments and Discord search results, and query fresher code symbols with revision provenance.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as the project mascot at a cozy retro workstation with several clearly distinct capabilities growing from one hub: an OpenAI-style API terminal streaming response lines, a crisp Mermaid diagram being rendered into a framed PNG, and a small Discord-search telescope finding neatly scoped message results. Polli wears tiny librarian-engineer glasses and gently tends code-plants labeled with symbols and revision tags; the monitor robot can eagerly hold a deployment stamp to represent Polli shipping independently.
